facts.fact: Q2 2026 reported sales were $25.3 Billion, up 6.6% (reported) year over year.
facts.quote: 2026 Second-Quarter reported sales growth of 6.6% to $25.3 Billion with operational growth of 5.6%* and adjusted operational growth of 5.7%*
facts.location: first bullet under the headline; also Reported Sales row of the overall financial results table ($25,310 million vs $23,743 million)
common_errors: giving operational growth of 5.6% or adjusted operational growth of 5.7% (non-GAAP) as the reported growth rate
using the CEO's rounded 'surpassing $25 billion' in place of $25.3 Billion

facts.fact: GAAP diluted EPS was $2.27, down 0.9% from $2.29 a year earlier.
facts.location: EPS (diluted) row of the GAAP overall financial results table; also second bullet under the headline
common_errors: presenting the adjusted EPS of $2.90 as GAAP EPS
saying GAAP EPS rose (it fell 0.9% while adjusted EPS rose 4.7%)
substituting the GAAP net earnings change of -0.1% for the EPS change

facts.fact: Adjusted diluted EPS (non-GAAP) was $2.90, up 4.7% from $2.77.
facts.location: Adjusted EPS (diluted) row of the non-GAAP overall financial results table; also second bullet under the headline
common_errors: calling $2.90 EPS without the adjusted or non-GAAP label
giving the adjusted net earnings growth of 5.7% as adjusted EPS growth

facts.fact: Innovative Medicine, the larger segment, had sales of $16,384 million, up 7.8% reported.
common_errors: giving operational growth of 6.8% or adjusted operational growth of 6.9% (non-GAAP) as the reported growth rate
reading $16,384 as thousands or billions rather than millions

facts.fact: Full-year 2026 adjusted EPS guidance (non-GAAP) was raised by $0.13 to $11.68 at the midpoint.
facts.quote: increasing adjusted EPS* guidance by $0.13 to $11.68 or 8.2% at the midpoint
facts.location: third bullet under the headline; Adjusted EPS (Diluted) row of the full-year 2026 guidance table (range $11.60 to $11.75, April midpoint $11.55)
common_errors: confusing with adjusted operational EPS guidance of $11.58, raised by $0.18
presenting the guidance as GAAP EPS guidance (the company gives no GAAP forward guidance)
stating the prior April midpoint of $11.55 as the new guidance

facts.fact: The headline is a raised 2026 outlook: estimated reported sales guidance is $101.1 Billion at the midpoint, 7.3% growth.
facts.quote: Strong operational performance results in the Company increasing 2026 guidance with estimated reported sales of $101.1 Billion or 7.3% at the midpoint
facts.location: headline ('raises 2026 outlook') and third bullet under the headline; Estimated Reported Sales row of the full-year 2026 guidance table (April midpoint $100.8B)
common_errors: confusing with operational sales guidance midpoint of $100.6B (non-GAAP, 6.8% growth)
confusing with adjusted operational sales growth guidance midpoint of 6.5%

labeling it GAAP guidance (the company says it does not provide GAAP measures on a forward-looking basis; estimated reported sales use an illustrative euro rate)

facts.fact: Operational sales growth (non-GAAP, excluding currency) was 5.6%, and adjusted operational growth (non-GAAP, also excluding acquisitions and divestitures) was 5.7%.
facts.quote: with operational growth of 5.6%* and adjusted operational growth of 5.7%*

facts.fact: STELARA had an approximate 760 basis points impact on Innovative Medicine operational growth, partially offsetting it alongside REMICADE, IMBRUVICA and ZYTIGA.
facts.quote: Growth was partially offset by STELARA (an approximate 760 basis points impact) and REMICADE in Immunology, as well as IMBRUVICA and ZYTIGA in Oncology.
equivalent_phrasings: STELARA cost about 760 basis points of growth
common_errors: applying the 760 basis points impact to total company growth instead of Innovative Medicine
confusing it with the 10 basis points divestiture impact

traps: Reported sales growth is 6.6%; operational (5.6%) and adjusted operational (5.7%) growth are non-GAAP and exclude currency.
GAAP diluted EPS fell 0.9% to $2.27 while adjusted EPS (non-GAAP) rose 4.7% to $2.90; reporting $2.90 as GAAP or saying EPS rose is wrong.
GAAP net earnings were $5,534 million, down 0.1%, while adjusted net earnings (non-GAAP) were $7,081 million, up 5.7%.
5.7% is both adjusted operational sales growth and adjusted net earnings growth; 7.3% is both the reported sales guidance growth midpoint and the adjusted operational EPS guidance growth midpoint.
Adjusted EPS guidance is $11.68 (raised $0.13); adjusted operational EPS guidance is $11.58 (raised $0.18). No GAAP guidance is given.
Estimated reported sales guidance midpoint is $101.1B; operational sales guidance midpoint is $100.6B; April midpoints were $100.8B and $100.2B.
Free cash flow of ~$8,700 million is a second-quarter year-to-date estimate and non-GAAP, not a quarterly or GAAP figure.
Segment and regional tables are in $ millions; the middle rows (International, MedTech) omit the $ and % signs.
International reported growth of 5.7% includes 2.3 points of currency; operational international growth was only 3.4% versus 7.3% in the U.S.
